_comment: Wizard-of-Oz stimulus + demo script. A real top-of-1st half-inning plus the start of the bottom. The facilitator taps the matching entry when the test scorer speaks the play. 'card' = which UI card renders. Deterministic plays = card A; judgment plays = card B (never auto-resolved). Notation is Reisner/Retrosheet-style. No fabricated stats — this is a constructed but rules-valid sequence for testing the interaction only.

game.context: 14U travel, scrimmage — neutral teams, illustrative only

plays.spoken_example: ground ball to short, threw him out at first
grounder to short, he bobbled it, runner safe at first
plays.question: Hit or error?

recommendation.why: Routine grounder misplayed by the shortstop — E6

plays.spoken_example: double down the line, runner to third
throwing error by the third baseman, a run scores
plays.question: That run — earned or unearned?

recommendation.why: A run scored in an inning with an error — earned/unearned can't be settled until the inning ends (Rule 9.16 deferred)

plays.note: This is the FR-010a case: attach earned_unearned=PENDING; never auto-tag.

plays.spoken_example: fielder's choice, they got the lead runner at home
plays.question: Who's credited — confirm the play?

recommendation.call: FC, out at home 2-... confirm fielders
recommendation.why: Fielder's choice; putout/assist credit depends on who covered

plays.prompt: Didn't catch that — say the play again, or tap to enter it.
plays.note: Facilitator triggers this to test FR-008: clarify, never guess.
